mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from OA_Project_Report mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_Id where mn.Wr_Id = #{wrId}

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, c1.C_Name as wrCName, c2.C_Name as wrContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as wrCAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as wrContractorAbbName, sd.D_Name as wrDName, sd1.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from OA_Work_Report mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Wr_C_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Wr_Contractor_Id = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Department sd1 on pro.P_Competent_Department = sd1.D_Id left join SYS_Department sd on mn.Wr_D_Id = sd.D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Wr_Id where mn.Wr_Id = #{wrId}
